name: AWS EC2-based cloud gaming PC for Meta Quest 3 VR

mentions.name: AWS EC2-based cloud gaming PC for Meta Quest 3 VR
mentions.description: This project builds a gaming PC hosted on AWS EC2 that streams Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and other games in full VR to a Meta Quest 3 headset, enabling cloud-based VR gaming without local hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a AWS ec2 based Gaming PC setup that will let me play Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (and other games) in full VR on a Meta Quest 3.

evidence.value: I'm making a AWS ec2 based Gaming PC setup that will let me play Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 (and other games) in full VR on a Meta Quest 3.
